raw: CHAPTER X. Two Promises
en: [Chapter 10]

raw: More months, to the number of twelve, had come and gone, and Mr. Charles Darnay was established in England as a higher teacher of the French language who was conversant with French literature.
en: Two Promises Twelve more months had passed, and Charles Darnay was established in England as a teacher of the French language and literature.
ko: 두 가지 약속 열두 달이 더 지났고, 찰스 다네이는 영국에서 프랑스어와 문학 교사로 자리 잡았다.

raw: In this age, he would have been a Professor; in that age, he was a Tutor.
en: Today he would be called a professor, but back then he was a tutor.
ko: 오늘날이라면 그는 교수라 불렸겠지만, 그 당시 그는 가정교사였다.

raw: He read with young men who could find any leisure and interest for the study of a living tongue spoken all over the world, and he cultivated a taste for its stores of knowledge and fancy.
en: He tutored young men who found the time and interest to study a living language that was spoken all over the world, and he helped them develop a taste for its wealth of knowledge and imagination.
ko: 그는 전 세계에서 쓰이는 살아있는 언어를 공부할 시간과 흥미를 찾은 젊은이들을 가르쳤고, 그들이 그 언어의 풍부한 지식과 상상력에 대한 안목을 기르도록 도왔다.

raw: He could write of them, besides, in sound English, and render them into sound English.
en: He was also a skilled translator who could write elegant English.
ko: 그는 또한 우아한 영어를 쓸 수 있는 숙련된 번역가이기도 했다.

raw: Such masters were not at that time easily found; Princes that had been, and Kings that were to be, were not yet of the Teacher class, and no ruined nobility had dropped out of Tellson’s ledgers, to turn cooks and carpenters.
en: Since good teachers were rare in those days, and ruined noblemen had not yet begun working as cooks and carpenters, young Mr.
ko: 그 당시에는 훌륭한 교사가 드물었고, 몰락한 귀족들이 아직 요리사나 목수로 일하기 시작하지 않았기 때문에, 젊은

raw: As a tutor, whose attainments made the student’s way unusually pleasant and profitable, and as an elegant translator who brought something to his work besides mere dictionary knowledge, young Mr.
en: As a tutor whose skills made learning unusually pleasant and rewarding, and as a graceful translator who brought more to his work than just dictionary knowledge, young Mr.
ko: 학습을 유난히 즐겁고 보람 있게 만드는 기술을 가진 가정교사로서, 그리고 단순한 사전적 지식 이상의 것을 자신의 일에 불어넣는 우아한 번역가로서, 젊은

raw: Darnay soon became known and encouraged. He was well acquainted, more-over, with the circumstances of his country, and those were of ever-growing interest.
en: He was also well-informed about the political situation in France, which was of growing interest to the English.
ko: 그는 또한 영국인들의 관심이 커지고 있던 프랑스의 정치 상황에 대해서도 잘 알고 있었다.

raw: So, with great perseverance and untiring industry, he prospered.
en: Through hard work and perseverance, he prospered.
ko: 노력과 끈기를 통해 그는 성공했다.

raw: In London, he had expected neither to walk on pavements of gold, nor to lie on beds of roses; if he had had any such exalted expectation, he would not have prospered.
en: He had not expected to find an easy life in London. If he had, he would not have succeeded.
ko: 그는 런던에서 편안한 삶을 찾을 것이라 기대하지 않았다. 만약 그랬다면 그는 성공하지 못했을 것이다.

raw: He had expected labour, and he found it, and did it and made the best of it.
en: He expected hard work, found it, and did it.
ko: 그는 힘든 일을 예상했고, 그것을 찾아냈으며, 해냈다.

raw: In this, his prosperity consisted.
en: His success came from his efforts.
ko: 그의 성공은 그의 노력에서 비롯되었다.

raw: A certain portion of his time was passed at Cambridge, where he read with undergraduates as a sort of tolerated smuggler who drove a contraband trade in European languages, instead of conveying Greek and Latin through the Custom-house.
en: He spent part of his time at Cambridge University, teaching students European languages, while others taught Greek and Latin.
ko: 그는 시간의 일부를 케임브리지 대학에서 보내며 학생들에게 유럽 언어를 가르쳤고, 다른 이들은 그리스어와 라틴어를 가르쳤다.

raw: The rest of his time he passed in London.
en: The rest of his time he spent in London.
ko: 나머지 시간은 런던에서 보냈다.

raw: Now, from the days when it was always summer in Eden, to these days when it is mostly winter in fallen latitudes, the world of a man has invariably gone one way--Charles Darnay’s way--the way of the love of a woman.
en: Ever since the world began, a man's life has always revolved around one thing, the love of a woman. And so it was for Charles Darnay.
ko: 세상이 시작된 이래로 남자의 삶은 항상 한 가지, 즉 여인에 대한 사랑을 중심으로 돌아갔다. 찰스 다네이의 경우도 그랬다.

raw: He had loved Lucie Manette from the hour of his danger.
en: He had loved Lucie Manette from the moment of his trial.
ko: 그는 재판의 순간부터 루시 마네트를 사랑해 왔다.

raw: He had never heard a sound so sweet and dear as the sound of her compassionate voice; he had never seen a face so tenderly beautiful, as hers when it was confronted with his own on the edge of the grave that had been dug for him.
en: He had never heard anything as sweet as her compassionate voice, or seen anyone as beautiful as she was when she stood before him in court.
ko: 그는 법정에서 그녀가 자신 앞에 섰을 때 그녀의 연민 어린 목소리만큼 달콤한 것을 들어본 적이 없었고, 그녀만큼 아름다운 사람을 본 적이 없었다.

raw: But, he had not yet spoken to her on the subject; the assassination at the deserted chateau far away beyond the heaving water and the long, long, dusty roads--the solid stone chateau which had itself become the mere mist of a dream--had been done a year, and he had never yet, by so much as a single spoken word, disclosed to her the state of his heart.
en: But he had not yet spoken to her about his feelings. A year had passed since the assassination at the castle in France, which now felt like a distant dream, and he had not yet told her that he loved her.
ko: 하지만 그는 아직 그녀에게 자신의 감정에 대해 말하지 않았다. 이제는 아득한 꿈처럼 느껴지는 프랑스 성에서의 암살 사건 이후 일 년이 지났지만, 그는 아직 자신이 그녀를 사랑한다고 말하지 않았다.

raw: That he had his reasons for this, he knew full well.
en: He had good reasons for waiting.
ko: 그가 기다린 데에는 그럴만한 이유가 있었다.

raw: It was again a summer day when, lately arrived in London from his college occupation, he turned into the quiet corner in Soho, bent on seeking an opportunity of opening his mind to Doctor Manette.
en: It was another summer day when, returning to London from his college work, he went to the quiet corner in Soho to speak to Doctor Manette.
ko: 대학 일을 마치고 런던으로 돌아오던 어느 여름날, 그는 마네트 박사와 이야기하기 위해 소호의 조용한 구석으로 갔다.

raw: It was the close of the summer day, and he knew Lucie to be out with Miss Pross.
en: It was late afternoon, and he knew Lucie was out with Miss Pross.
ko: 늦은 오후였고, 그는 루시가 프로스 양과 함께 외출했다는 것을 알고 있었다.

raw: He found the Doctor reading in his arm-chair at a window.
en: He found the Doctor reading in his armchair by the window.
ko: 그는 박사가 창가 암체어에 앉아 책을 읽고 있는 것을 발견했다.

raw: The energy which had at once supported him under his old sufferings and aggravated their sharpness, had been gradually restored to him.
en: The energy that had once supported him in prison had slowly returned.
ko: 감옥에서 한때 그를 지탱해주던 에너지가 서서히 돌아왔다.

raw: He was now a very energetic man indeed, with great firmness of purpose, strength of resolution, and vigour of action.
en: He was now a very active man with strong determination.
ko: 그는 이제 강한 결단력을 지닌 매우 활동적인 남자가 되었다.

raw: In his recovered energy he was sometimes a little fitful and sudden, as he had at first been in the exercise of his other recovered faculties; but, this had never been frequently observable, and had grown more and more rare.
en: In his newly recovered energy, he was sometimes a little restless and sudden, just as he had been when he first regained his other abilities; but this had never been very common, and it had grown more and more rare.
ko: 새로 회복된 에너지 속에서 그는 처음 다른 능력들을 되찾았을 때처럼 가끔 약간 안절부절못하고 갑작스럽게 행동하기도 했지만, 이런 일은 결코 흔치 않았으며 갈수록 더 드물어졌다.

raw: He studied much, slept little, sustained a great deal of fatigue with ease, and was equably cheerful.
en: He studied a lot, slept little, handled fatigue easily, and was generally cheerful.
ko: 그는 공부를 많이 하고 잠을 적게 잤으며, 피로를 쉽게 이겨냈고 대체로 명랑했다.

raw: To him, now entered Charles Darnay, at sight of whom he laid aside his book and held out his hand.
en: When Darnay entered, the Doctor laid aside his book and held out his hand.
ko: 다네이가 들어오자, 박사는 책을 내려놓고 손을 내밀었다.

raw: “Charles Darnay!
en: "Charles Darnay!
ko: "찰스 다네이!

raw: I rejoice to see you.
en: I am glad to see you.
ko: 만나서 반갑네.

raw: We have been counting on your return these three or four days past.
en: We have been expecting you for a few days.
ko: 우리는 며칠 동안 자네를 기다리고 있었네.

raw: Mr.
en: Mr.
ko: 미스터

raw: Stryver and Sydney Carton were both here yesterday, and both made you out to be more than due.”
en: Stryver and Sydney Carton were here yesterday, and both said you were overdue."
ko: 어제 스트라이버와 시드니 카턴이 다녀갔는데, 두 사람 모두 당신이 늦는다고 말하더군요.

raw: “I am obliged to them for their interest in the matter,” he answered, a little coldly as to them, though very warmly as to the Doctor. “Miss Manette--”
en: "I am grateful for their interest," Darnay replied, speaking coldly of them but warmly to the Doctor. "Miss Manette, "
ko: "그들의 관심에 감사드립니다," 다네이가 그들에겐 차갑게, 하지만 의사에게는 따뜻하게 말했다. "마네트 양은, "

raw: “Is well,” said the Doctor, as he stopped short, “and your return will delight us all.
en: "Is well," the Doctor said, interrupting. "Your return will please us all.
ko: "잘 있습니다," 의사가 말을 가로막으며 말했다. "당신이 돌아와서 우리 모두 기뻐할 겁니다.

raw: She has gone out on some household matters, but will soon be home.”
en: She is out buying household goods but will return soon."
ko: 가정용품을 사러 나갔는데 곧 돌아올 겁니다."

raw: “Doctor Manette, I knew she was from home.
en: "Doctor Manette, I knew she was out.
ko: "마네트 박사님, 저는 그녀가 외출한 것을 알고 있었습니다.

raw: I took the opportunity of her being from home, to beg to speak to you.”
en: I took this opportunity to speak with you alone."
ko: 박사님과 단둘이 말씀드릴 기회를 잡은 것입니다."

raw: There was a blank silence.
en: A long silence followed.
ko: 긴 침묵이 이어졌다.

raw: “Yes?” said the Doctor, with evident constraint. “Bring your chair here, and speak on.”
en: "Yes?" the Doctor said with clear discomfort. "Bring your chair here and speak."
ko: "네?" 의사가 명백히 불편한 기색으로 말했다. "의자를 이쪽으로 가져와서 말씀하시지요."

raw: He complied as to the chair, but appeared to find the speaking on less easy.
en: Darnay sat down but found it hard to start.
ko: 다네이는 자리에 앉았지만 말을 꺼내기가 어려웠다.

raw: “I have had the happiness, Doctor Manette, of being so intimate here,”  so he at length began, “for some year and a half, that I hope the topic on which I am about to touch may not--”
en: "I have been close with your family for a year and a half, Doctor Manette, and I hope the subject I want to discuss won't, "
ko: "마네트 박사님, 저는 지난 일 년 반 동안 박사님 가족과 가깝게 지내왔습니다. 제가 드리고 싶은 말씀이 혹시라도, "

raw: He was stayed by the Doctor’s putting out his hand to stop him.
en: The Doctor put up his hand to stop him.
ko: 의사는 손을 들어 그를 멈추게 했다.

raw: When he had kept it so a little while, he said, drawing it back:
en: After a moment, he drew his hand back and said:
ko: 잠시 후, 그는 손을 거두며 말했다:

raw: “Is Lucie the topic?”
en: "Is Lucie the subject?"
ko: "루시에 관한 이야기입니까?"

raw: “She is.”
en: "She is."
ko: "그렇습니다."

raw: “It is hard for me to speak of her at any time.
en: "It is hard for me to speak of her, Charles Darnay.
ko: "찰스 다네이, 그녀에 대해 말하는 건 제게 힘든 일입니다.

raw: It is very hard for me to hear her spoken of in that tone of yours, Charles Darnay.”
en: It is very hard for me to hear her spoken of in that way."
ko: 그녀가 그런 식으로 거론되는 것을 듣는 것은 제게 매우 힘든 일입니다."

raw: “It is a tone of fervent admiration, true homage, and deep love, Doctor Manette!” he said deferentially.
en: "It is a tone of deep admiration and love, Doctor Manette!" Darnay said respectfully.
ko: "그것은 깊은 존경과 사랑의 어조입니다, 마네트 박사님!" 다네이가 정중하게 말했다.

raw: There was another blank silence before her father rejoined:
en: Another silence followed before the father replied:
ko: 또 한 번의 침묵이 흐른 뒤, 아버지가 대답했다:

raw: “I believe it.
en: "I believe you.
ko: "당신을 믿습니다.

raw: I do you justice; I believe it.”
en: I know you mean it."
ko: 당신이 진심이라는 것을 압니다."

raw: His constraint was so manifest, and it was so manifest, too, that it originated in an unwillingness to approach the subject, that Charles Darnay hesitated.
en: The Doctor's discomfort and his reluctance to discuss the subject were so clear that Darnay hesitated.
ko: 이 주제에 대해 논의하는 것에 대한 의사의 불편함과 꺼림칙함이 너무나 분명해서 다네이는 망설였다.

raw: “Shall I go on, sir?”
en: "Shall I continue, sir?"
ko: "계속 말씀드려도 되겠습니까, 박사님?"

raw: Another blank.
en: Another pause.
ko: 다시 한 번 멈춤.

raw: “Yes, go on.”
en: "Yes, go on."
ko: "네, 계속하세요."

raw: “You anticipate what I would say, though you cannot know how earnestly I say it, how earnestly I feel it, without knowing my secret heart, and the hopes and fears and anxieties with which it has long been laden.
en: "You guess what I want to say, though you cannot know how earnestly I say it, or how deeply I feel it, without knowing my secret heart and the hopes, fears, and anxieties that have weighed it down for so long.
ko: "제가 무슨 말을 하려는지 짐작하시겠지만, 오랫동안 제 비밀스러운 마음을 짓눌러 온 희망과 두려움, 그리고 불안을 아시지 못한다면, 제가 얼마나 간절하게 말하는지, 또 얼마나 깊이 느끼고 있는지 모르실 겁니다.

raw: Dear Doctor Manette, I love your daughter fondly, dearly, disinterestedly, devotedly.
en: Dear Doctor Manette, I love your daughter dearly and devotedly.
ko: 친애하는 마네트 박사님, 저는 따님을 진심으로 열렬히 사랑합니다.

raw: If ever there were love in the world, I love her.
en: If there is true love in this world, I feel it for her.
ko: 이 세상에 진정한 사랑이 존재한다면, 저는 그녀에게 그것을 느낍니다.

raw: You have loved yourself; let your old love speak for me!”
en: You have loved in your life; let that memory speak for me!"
ko: 박사님도 인생에서 사랑을 해보셨을 테니, 그 기억이 저를 대변하게 해 주십시오!"

raw: The Doctor sat with his face turned away, and his eyes bent on the ground.
en: The Doctor sat with his face turned away, looking at the floor.
ko: 의사는 바닥을 내려다보며 얼굴을 돌린 채 앉아 있었다.

raw: At the last words, he stretched out his hand again, hurriedly, and cried:
en: At these words, he stretched out his hand quickly and cried:
ko: 이 말에 그는 재빨리 손을 뻗으며 소리쳤다:

raw: “Not that, sir!
en: "Not that, sir!
ko: "그건 안 됩니다!

raw: Let that be!
en: Leave that alone!
ko: 그건 그냥 두시오!

raw: I adjure you, do not recall that!”
en: I beg you, do not bring that up!"
ko: 부탁이니 그 이야기는 꺼내지 마시오!"

raw: His cry was so like a cry of actual pain, that it rang in Charles Darnay’s ears long after he had ceased.
en: His cry sounded so much like a cry of real physical pain that it rang in Charles Darnay’s ears long after he had stopped.
ko: 그의 외침은 마치 실제 육체적 고통의 비명처럼 들려서, 그가 말을 멈춘 후에도 오랫동안 찰스 다네이의 귀에 맴돌았다.

raw: He motioned with the hand he had extended, and it seemed to be an appeal to Darnay to pause. The latter so received it, and remained silent.
en: He gestured with his outstretched hand, and it seemed like a plea for Darnay to pause. Darnay understood it that way and remained silent.
ko: 그는 뻗은 손으로 몸짓을 했고, 그것은 다네이에게 멈춰 달라는 간청처럼 보였다. 다네이도 그렇게 이해하고 침묵을 지켰다.

raw: “I ask your pardon,” said the Doctor, in a subdued tone, after some moments. “I do not doubt your loving Lucie; you may be satisfied of it.”
en: "Forgive me," the Doctor said quietly after a few moments. "I do not doubt your love for Lucie. You may be sure of that."
ko: "용서하시오," 몇 순간이 지난 후 의사가 조용히 말했다. "루시를 향한 당신의 사랑은 의심하지 않습니다. 그 점은 확실히 아셔도 됩니다."

raw: He turned towards him in his chair, but did not look at him, or raise his eyes.
en: He turned toward Darnay but did not look him in the eye.
ko: 그는 다네이 쪽으로 고개를 돌렸으나, 그의 눈을 마주치지는 않았다.

raw: His chin dropped upon his hand, and his white hair overshadowed his face:
en: He rested his chin on his hand, his white hair covering his face.
ko: 그는 하얀 머리카락이 얼굴을 덮은 채 턱을 손에 괴었다.

raw: “Have you spoken to Lucie?”
en: "Have you spoken to Lucie?"
ko: "루시와 이야기를 나누었습니까?"

raw: “No.”
en: "No."
ko: "아닙니다."

raw: “Nor written?”
en: "Or written to her?"
ko: "아니면 편지를 썼습니까?"

raw: “Never.”
en: "Never."
ko: "절대 그렇지 않습니다."

raw: “It would be ungenerous to affect not to know that your self-denial is to be referred to your consideration for her father.
en: "I know your silence is out of respect for me as her father.
ko: "당신의 침묵이 그녀의 아버지인 나를 존중하기 때문이라는 것을 압니다.

raw: Her father thanks you.”
en: I thank you for that."
ko: 그 점에 감사드립니다."

raw: He offered his hand; but his eyes did not go with it.
en: He offered his hand, but did not look up.
ko: 그는 손을 내밀었지만 고개를 들지는 않았다.

raw: “I know,” said Darnay, respectfully, “how can I fail to know, Doctor Manette, I who have seen you together from day to day, that between you and Miss Manette there is an affection so unusual, so touching, so belonging to the circumstances in which it has been nurtured, that it can have few parallels, even in the tenderness between a father and child.
en: "I know," said Darnay respectfully, "how could I not know, Doctor Manette, when I have seen you together day after day? The love between you and Miss Manette is so unusual, so touching, and so deeply tied to the circumstances in which it grew, that few things can compare to it, even in the tenderness between a father and a child.
ko: "압니다," 다네이가 정중하게 말했다. "마네트 박사님, 두 분이 함께 계신 모습을 매일 보아왔는데 어찌 모르겠습니까? 박사님과 마네트 양 사이의 사랑은 너무나 특별하고, 너무나 감동적이며, 그것이 자라난 상황과 너무나 깊이 연결되어 있어서, 심지어 아버지와 자식 간의 다정함 중에서도 비교할 수 있는 것이 거의 없습니다.

raw: I know, Doctor Manette--how can I fail to know--that, mingled with the affection and duty of a daughter who has become a woman, there is, in her heart, towards you, all the love and reliance of infancy itself.
en: It has few equals, even between father and child. I know that Lucie loves and relies on you completely.
ko: 심지어 아버지와 자식 사이에도 그에 필적할 만한 것이 거의 없습니다. 저는 루시가 박사님을 전적으로 사랑하고 의지한다는 것을 압니다.

raw: I know that, as in her childhood she had no parent, so she is now devoted to you with all the constancy and fervour of her present years and character, united to the trustfulness and attachment of the early days in which you were lost to her.
en: I know that because she had no parent in her childhood, she is now devoted to you with all the loyalty and passion of her current age and character, combined with the deep trust and attachment of those early days when you were lost to her.
ko: 어린 시절 부모가 없었기에, 지금 그녀는 자신의 현재 나이와 성격에 걸맞은 모든 충성심과 열정을 바쳐 당신에게 헌신하고 있으며, 거기에 당신을 잃어버렸던 그 어린 시절의 깊은 신뢰와 애착이 더해져 있다는 것을 저는 압니다.

raw: I know perfectly well that if you had been restored to her from the world beyond this life, you could hardly be invested, in her sight, with a more sacred character than that in which you are always with her.
en: I know perfectly well that even if you had been brought back to her from the dead, she could hardly see you as a more sacred figure than the one you already are to her every day.
ko: 당신이 죽음에서 돌아와 그녀에게 돌아왔다 하더라도, 그녀가 당신을 지금 매일 그녀에게 존재하는 것보다 더 신성한 인물로 여길 수는 거의 없다는 것을 저는 아주 잘 압니다.

raw: I know that when she is clinging to you, the hands of baby, girl, and woman, all in one, are round your neck.
en: When she hugs you, she holds you with the love of a baby, a girl, and a woman all in one.
ko: 그녀가 당신을 안을 때, 그녀는 아기와 소녀, 그리고 여자의 사랑을 하나로 합쳐서 당신을 안습니다.

raw: I know that in loving you she sees and loves her mother at her own age, sees and loves you at my age, loves her mother broken-hearted, loves you through your dreadful trial and in your blessed restoration.
en: I know that in loving you, she sees and loves her mother at her own age, sees and loves you at my age, loves her heartbroken mother, and loves you through your terrible suffering and your blessed recovery.
ko: 당신을 사랑함에 있어서, 그녀는 자신의 나이였을 때의 어머니를 보고 사랑하며, 제 나이였을 때의 당신을 보고 사랑하며, 상심한 어머니를 사랑하고, 당신의 끔찍한 고통과 축복받은 회복을 거친 당신을 사랑한다는 것을 저는 압니다.

raw: I have known this, night and day, since I have known you in your home.”
en: I have known this, night and day, ever since I have known you in your home."
ko: 당신 댁에서 당신을 알게 된 이후로 밤낮없이 이 사실을 알고 있었습니다."

raw: Her father sat silent, with his face bent down.
en: Her father sat silent, his face down.
ko: 그녀의 아버지는 고개를 숙인 채 말없이 앉아 있었다.

raw: His breathing was a little quickened; but he repressed all other signs of agitation.
en: His breathing was faster, but he controlled his emotions.
ko: 그의 호흡은 빨라졌지만, 그는 감정을 억제했다.

raw: “Dear Doctor Manette, always knowing this, always seeing her and you with this hallowed light about you, I have forborne, and forborne, as long as it was in the nature of man to do it.
en: "Dear Doctor Manette, because I have always known this, and always seen you both surrounded by this sacred light, I have held back and kept silent for as long as humanly possible.
ko: "친애하는 마네트 박사님, 저는 항상 이것을 알고 있었고 두 분이 이 신성한 빛에 둘러싸여 있는 것을 늘 보아왔기 때문에 인간으로서 가능한 한 오랫동안 참고 침묵을 지켰습니다.

raw: I have felt, and do even now feel, that to bring my love--even mine--between you, is to touch your history with something not quite so good as itself.
en: I felt that bringing my love between you would interfere with your special bond.
ko: 두 분 사이에 제 사랑을 끌어들이는 것이 그 특별한 유대를 방해할 것이라고 느꼈습니다.

raw: But I love her.
en: But I love her.
ko: 하지만 저는 그녀를 사랑합니다.

raw: Heaven is my witness that I love her!”
en: God is my witness that I love her!"
ko: 제가 그녀를 사랑한다는 것은 신이 증인입니다!"

raw: “I believe it,” answered her father, mournfully. “I have thought so before now.
en: "I believe you," her father said sadly. "I have thought so before.
ko: "당신을 믿습니다," 그녀의 아버지가 슬프게 말했다. "전에도 그렇게 생각했습니다.

raw: I believe it.”
en: I believe you."
ko: 당신을 믿습니다."

raw: “But, do not believe,” said Darnay, upon whose ear the mournful voice struck with a reproachful sound, “that if my fortune were so cast as that, being one day so happy as to make her my wife, I must at any time put any separation between her and you, I could or would breathe a word of what I now say.
en: Darnay heard the sadness in the Doctor's voice. "But please do not think that if I were lucky enough to marry her, I would ever separate her from you," he said.
ko: 다네이는 의사의 목소리에 담긴 슬픔을 들었다. "하지만 제가 운이 좋아 그녀와 결혼하게 되더라도 그녀를 박사님에게서 떼어놓을 것이라고는 부디 생각하지 마십시오," 그가 말했다.

raw: Besides that I should know it to be hopeless, I should know it to be a baseness.
en: Not only would I know it to be hopeless, but I would also know it to be a shameful thing to do.
ko: 그것이 가망 없는 일이라는 것을 알 뿐만 아니라, 부끄러운 짓이라는 것도 알 것입니다.

raw: If I had any such possibility, even at a remote distance of years, harboured in my thoughts, and hidden in my heart--if it ever had been there--if it ever could be there--I could not now touch this honoured hand.”
en: That would be selfish and wrong. If I had any intention of separating you, I could not face you today."
ko: 그것은 이기적이고 잘못된 일일 것입니다. 만약 제가 두 분을 갈라놓을 의도가 조금이라도 있었다면 오늘 박사님을 뵐 수 없었을 것입니다."

raw: He laid his own upon it as he spoke.
en: He laid his hand on the Doctor's hand.
ko: 그는 의사의 손에 자신의 손을 얹었다.

raw: “No, dear Doctor Manette.
en: "No, dear Doctor Manette.
ko: "아닙니다, 친애하는 마네트 박사님.

raw: Like you, a voluntary exile from France; like you, driven from it by its distractions, oppressions, and miseries; like you, striving to live away from it by my own exertions, and trusting in a happier future; I look only to sharing your fortunes, sharing your life and home, and being faithful to you to the death.
en: Like you, I am a voluntary exile from France, driven away by its misery and oppression. Like you, I am trying to build a new life here through my own work. I only want to share your lives, and be faithful to you both to the end.
ko: 박사님처럼, 저도 조국의 비참함과 억압에 쫓겨 프랑스에서 자발적으로 망명한 사람입니다. 박사님처럼, 저도 제 일을 통해 이곳에서 새로운 삶을 꾸리려 노력하고 있습니다. 저는 그저 두 분의 삶을 나누고, 끝까지 두 분 모두에게 충실하고 싶을 뿐입니다.

raw: Not to divide with Lucie her privilege as your child, companion, and friend; but to come in aid of it, and bind her closer to you, if such a thing can be.”
en: My goal is not to divide Lucie's privilege as your child, companion, and friend, but to help support it, and to bind her even closer to you, if such a thing is possible."
ko: 제 목표는 당신의 자녀이자 동반자, 그리고 친구로서 루시가 가진 특권을 나누는 것이 아니라 그것을 지지하도록 돕고, 만약 그런 일이 가능하다면 그녀를 당신에게 더욱 굳게 결속시키는 것입니다."

raw: His touch still lingered on her father’s hand.
en: His hand remained on the Doctor's.
ko: 그의 손은 의사의 손 위에 그대로 있었다.

raw: Answering the touch for a moment, but not coldly, her father rested his hands upon the arms of his chair, and looked up for the first time since the beginning of the conference.
en: Responding to the touch, the Doctor rested his hands on his chair and looked up for the first time.
ko: 그 손길에 반응하듯, 의사는 의자에 손을 얹고 처음으로 고개를 들었다.

raw: A struggle was evidently in his face; a struggle with that occasional look which had a tendency in it to dark doubt and dread.
en: His face showed a struggle with his old look of fear and doubt.
ko: 그의 얼굴에는 예전의 두려움과 의심 어린 표정과 싸우는 모습이 역력했다.

raw: “You speak so feelingly and so manfully, Charles Darnay, that I thank you with all my heart, and will open all my heart--or nearly so.
en: "You speak very sincerely, Charles Darnay. I thank you, and I will open my heart to you.
ko: "당신은 매우 진심으로 말하고 있군요, 찰스 다네이. 감사합니다. 당신에게 제 마음을 열겠습니다.

raw: Have you any reason to believe that Lucie loves you?”
en: Do you have any reason to believe Lucie loves you?"
ko: 루시가 당신을 사랑한다고 믿을 만한 이유가 있습니까?"

raw: “None.
en: "None.
ko: "전혀 없습니다.

raw: As yet, none.”
en: Not yet."
ko: 아직은요."

raw: “Is it the immediate object of this confidence, that you may at once ascertain that, with my knowledge?”
en: "Do you want to find out right away, with my permission?"
ko: "제 허락을 얻어 당장 알아보고 싶습니까?"

raw: “Not even so.
en: "No.
ko: "아닙니다.

raw: I might not have the hopefulness to do it for weeks; I might (mistaken or not mistaken) have that hopefulness to-morrow.”
en: I might not have the courage to ask her for weeks; or I might ask her tomorrow."
ko: 몇 주 동안 그녀에게 물어볼 용기가 나지 않을지도 모릅니다. 아니면 내일 물어볼 수도 있겠죠."

raw: “Do you seek any guidance from me?”
en: "Do you want my advice?"
ko: "내 조언을 원합니까?"

raw: “I ask none, sir.
en: "No, sir.
ko: "아닙니다, 박사님.

raw: But I have thought it possible that you might have it in your power, if you should deem it right, to give me some.”
en: But I thought you might give me some guidance if you thought it right."
ko: 하지만 박사님께서 옳다고 생각하신다면 제게 어떤 지침을 주실 수도 있다고 생각했습니다."

raw: “Do you seek any promise from me?”
en: "Do you want a promise from me?"
ko: "나에게서 약속을 원합니까?"

raw: “I do seek that.”
en: "Yes, I do."
ko: "네, 그렇습니다."

raw: “What is it?”
en: "What is it?"
ko: "무엇입니까?"

raw: “I well understand that, without you, I could have no hope.
en: "I know that without your approval, I have no hope.
ko: "박사님의 승낙 없이는 저에게 희망이 없다는 것을 압니다.

raw: I well understand that, even if Miss Manette held me at this moment in her innocent heart--do not think I have the presumption to assume so much--I could retain no place in it against her love for her father.”
en: I fully understand that even if Miss Manette held me in her innocent heart right now—and please don't think I am arrogant enough to assume she does—I could never keep a place in it if it went against her love for her father."
ko: 만약 지금 마네트 양이 그녀의 순수한 마음속에 저를 담고 있다 하더라도—제가 그렇다고 단정할 만큼 오만하다고는 제발 생각하지 말아 주십시오—그것이 아버지를 향한 그녀의 사랑에 어긋난다면 저는 결코 그 마음에 머물 수 없다는 것을 충분히 이해합니다."

raw: “If that be so, do you see what, on the other hand, is involved in it?”
en: "If that is true, do you see what else it means?"
ko: "만약 그것이 사실이라면, 그것이 또 다른 무엇을 의미하는지 아십니까?"

raw: “I understand equally well, that a word from her father in any suitor’s favour, would outweigh herself and all the world.
en: Darnay said firmly, "I know that a word from you in favor of any suitor would decide the matter for her.
ko: 다네이가 단호하게 말했다. "박사님께서 어떤 구혼자를 지지하는 말씀 한마디만 하셔도 그녀를 위해 그 문제가 결정될 것이라는 점을 저는 압니다.

raw: For which reason, Doctor Manette,” said Darnay, modestly but firmly, “I would not ask that word, to save my life.”
en: For that reason, Doctor Manette, I would never ask you to speak for me."
ko: 그런 이유로, 마네트 박사님, 저는 결코 저를 위해 말씀해 달라고 부탁드리지 않을 것입니다."

raw: “I am sure of it.
en: "I am sure of that.
ko: "저도 그럴 것이라 확신합니다.

raw: Charles Darnay, mysteries arise out of close love, as well as out of wide division; in the former case, they are subtle and delicate, and difficult to penetrate.
en: Charles Darnay, mysteries can come from deep love just as much as from deep division; but when they come from love, they are subtle, delicate, and difficult to figure out.
ko: 찰스 다네이, 신비로움은 깊은 분열에서 비롯되는 것 못지않게 깊은 사랑에서도 올 수 있습니다. 하지만 그것이 사랑에서 비롯될 때, 그것은 미묘하고 섬세하며 알아내기 어렵습니다.

raw: My daughter Lucie is, in this one respect, such a mystery to me; I can make no guess at the state of her heart.”
en: My daughter Lucie is a mystery to me in this regard; I do not know if she loves you."
ko: 이 점에서 내 딸 루시는 나에게 수수께끼입니다. 그녀가 당신을 사랑하는지 나도 모릅니다."

raw: “May I ask, sir, if you think she is--” As he hesitated, her father supplied the rest.
en: "May I ask, sir, if anyone else is seeking her love?"
ko: "박사님, 혹시 다른 누군가가 그녀의 사랑을 구하고 있는지 여쭤봐도 되겠습니까?"

raw: “Is sought by any other suitor?” “It is what I meant to say.” Her father considered a little before he answered:
en: "You have seen Mr. Carton here. Mr. Stryver is here too. If anyone is, it is one of them."
ko: "당신도 여기서 카턴 씨를 보았지요. 스트라이버 씨도 여기에 옵니다. 만약 누군가 있다면 그들 중 한 명일 것입니다."

raw: “You have seen Mr. Carton here, yourself. Mr. Stryver is here too, occasionally. If it be at all, it can only be by one of these.”
en: "You have seen Mr. Carton here yourself. Mr. Stryver is here sometimes, too. If she is being sought by anyone, it can only be by one of these two."
ko: "당신 스스로 여기서 카턴 씨를 보았소. 스트라이버 씨도 가끔 여기에 옵니다. 그녀가 누군가에게 구혼을 받고 있다면, 이 두 사람 중 하나일 수밖에 없습니다."

raw: “Or both,” said Darnay. “I had not thought of both; I should not think either, likely.
en: "I had not thought of both, and I think neither is likely.
ko: "두 사람 다 생각하지 못했습니다만, 어느 쪽도 그럴 것 같지는 않습니다.

raw: You want a promise from me. Tell me what it is.”
en: What is the promise you want from me?"
ko: 당신이 나에게 원하는 약속은 무엇입니까?"

raw: “It is, that if Miss Manette should bring to you at any time, on her own part, such a confidence as I have ventured to lay before you, you will bear testimony to what I have said, and to your belief in it.
en: "It is that if Lucie ever tells you she loves me, you will tell her what I have said today, and that you believe me.
ko: "만약 언젠가 루시가 당신을 사랑한다고 박사님께 말한다면, 제가 오늘 드린 말씀을 그녀에게 전해주시고, 박사님께서 저를 믿는다고 말씀해 주시는 것입니다.

raw: I hope you may be able to think so well of me, as to urge no influence against me. I say nothing more of my stake in this; this is what I ask.
en: I hope you will think highly enough of me to not use your influence against me. I will say no more about my own feelings in this matter; this is all I ask.
ko: 박사님께서 저를 충분히 높이 평가하셔서 저에게 불리하게 영향력을 행사하지 않으시기를 바랍니다. 이 문제에 대한 제 감정에 대해서는 더 이상 말씀드리지 않겠습니다. 이것이 제가 부탁드리는 전부입니다.

raw: The condition on which I ask it, and which you have an undoubted right to require, I will observe immediately.”
en: That is all I ask, and I will keep my part of the agreement."
ko: 그것이 제가 부탁하는 전부이며, 저는 저의 합의를 지킬 것입니다."

raw: “I give the promise,” said the Doctor, “without any condition. I believe your object to be, purely and truthfully, as you have stated it.
en: "I give you my promise," said the Doctor, "without any conditions. I believe your goals are pure and truthful, exactly as you have stated them.
ko: "당신에게 약속하겠습니다," 의사가 말했다. "아무런 조건 없이요. 당신의 목적이 방금 말한 대로 순수하고 진실하다고 믿습니다.

raw: I believe your intention is to perpetuate, and not to weaken, the ties between me and my other and far dearer self.
en: "I believe your love is genuine, and that you want to bring us closer together, not separate us.
ko: "당신의 사랑은 진심이며, 당신이 우리를 떼어놓으려는 것이 아니라 더 가깝게 이어주려 한다는 것을 믿네.

raw: If she should ever tell me that you are essential to her perfect happiness, I will give her to you.
en: If she ever tells me that you are necessary for her happiness, I will give her to you.
ko: 만약 그녀가 자신의 행복을 위해 자네가 필요하다고 내게 말한다면, 그녀를 자네에게 주겠네.

raw: If there were--Charles Darnay, if there were--”
en: If there were, Charles Darnay, if there were, "
ko: 찰스 다네이, 만약 그런 것이 있다면, 만약 그렇다면,"

raw: The young man had taken his hand gratefully; their hands were joined as the Doctor spoke:
en: The young man took his hand gratefully as the Doctor continued:
ko: 청년은 감사한 마음으로 그의 손을 잡았고 의사는 계속해서 말했다.

raw: “--any fancies, any reasons, any apprehensions, anything whatsoever, new or old, against the man she really loved--the direct responsibility thereof not lying on his head--they should all be obliterated for her sake.
en: ", any reasons or fears against the man she loved, as long as he was not responsible for them, they would be forgotten for her sake.
ko: ", 그녀가 사랑하는 남자에 대한 어떤 이유나 두려움이 있더라도, 그가 그에 대한 책임이 없는 한 그녀를 위해 잊혀질 것이네.

raw: She is everything to me; more to me than suffering, more to me than wrong, more to me--Well!
en: She is everything to me. She is worth more than all my past suffering.
ko: 그녀는 내게 모든 것이라네. 그녀는 내 모든 과거의 고통보다 더 가치가 있어.

raw: This is idle talk.”
en: But this is idle talk."
ko: 하지만 이건 쓸데없는 소리군."

raw: So strange was the way in which he faded into silence, and so strange his fixed look when he had ceased to speak, that Darnay felt his own hand turn cold in the hand that slowly released and dropped it.
en: The Doctor suddenly fell silent, his face turning blank. Darnay felt the Doctor's hand turn cold as it released his.
ko: 의사는 갑자기 말문을 닫았고 그의 얼굴은 멍해졌다. 다네이는 의사의 손이 차가워지며 그의 손을 놓는 것을 느꼈다.

raw: “You said something to me,” said Doctor Manette, breaking into a smile. “What was it you said to me?”
en: "You said something to me," Doctor Manette said, smiling suddenly. "What was it?"
ko: "자네가 내게 무슨 말을 했지." 마네트 의사가 갑자기 미소를 지으며 말했다. "그게 뭐였나?"

raw: He was at a loss how to answer, until he remembered having spoken of a condition. Relieved as his mind reverted to that, he answered:
en: He wasn't sure how to answer, until he remembered that he had mentioned a condition earlier. Relieved to have thought of it, he answered:
ko: 그는 어떻게 대답해야 할지 몰랐지만, 조금 전 조건에 대해 언급했던 것이 생각났다. 다행히 그것을 떠올린 그는 대답했다.

raw: “Your confidence in me ought to be returned with full confidence on my part.
en: "I want to be completely honest with you, as you are with me.
ko: "선생님께서 제게 그러시듯, 저도 선생님께 완전히 솔직해지고 싶습니다.

raw: My present name, though but slightly changed from my mother’s, is not, as you will remember, my own.
en: My name is not my real one, though it is similar to my mother's.
ko: 제 이름은 제 진짜 이름이 아니며, 비록 제 어머니의 이름과 비슷하기는 하지만 말입니다.

raw: I wish to tell you what that is, and why I am in England.”
en: I want to tell you my real name, and why I am in England."
ko: 제 진짜 이름과 제가 왜 영국에 있는지 선생님께 말씀드리고 싶습니다."

raw: “Stop!” said the Doctor of Beauvais.
en: "Stop!" said the Doctor.
ko: "그만!" 의사가 말했다.

raw: “I wish it, that I may the better deserve your confidence, and have no secret from you.”
en: "I want to tell you so there are no secrets between us."
ko: "우리 사이에 비밀이 없도록 말씀드리고 싶습니다."

raw: “Stop!”
en: "Stop!"
ko: "그만!"

raw: For an instant, the Doctor even had his two hands at his ears; for another instant, even had his two hands laid on Darnay’s lips.
en: The Doctor put his hands over his ears, then placed them on Darnay's lips.
ko: 의사는 두 손으로 자신의 귀를 덮었다가, 이내 다네이의 입술 위에 올려놓았다.

raw: “Tell me when I ask you, not now.
en: "Tell me only if Lucie accepts you.
ko: "루시가 자네를 받아들일 때만 내게 말하게.

raw: If your suit should prosper, if Lucie should love you, you shall tell me on your marriage morning.
en: If your proposal is successful, and if Lucie does love you, you shall tell me your real name on the morning of your marriage.
ko: 자네의 청혼이 성공하고 루시가 진정으로 자네를 사랑한다면, 자네가 결혼하는 날 아침에 내게 진짜 이름을 말하게.

raw: Do you promise?”
en: Do you promise?"
ko: 약속하겠나?"

raw: “Willingly.
en: "I promise."
ko: "약속합니다."

raw: “Give me your hand.
en: "Give me your hand.
ko: "자네 손을 주게.

raw: She will be home directly, and it is better she should not see us together to-night.
en: She will be home soon, and it is better she does not see us together tonight.
ko: 그녀가 곧 집에 올 테니, 오늘 밤엔 우리가 함께 있는 것을 그녀가 보지 않는 편이 좋겠어.

raw: Go! God bless you!”
en: Go, and God bless you!"
ko: 어서 가보게, 신의 축복이 있기를!"

raw: It was dark when Charles Darnay left him, and it was an hour later and darker when Lucie came home; she hurried into the room alone--for Miss Pross had gone straight up-stairs--and was surprised to find his reading-chair empty.
en: It was dark when Charles Darnay left, and an hour later when Lucie came home. She entered the room alone, Miss Pross having gone upstairs, and was surprised to find her father's chair empty.
ko: 찰스 다네이가 떠났을 때는 어두웠고, 한 시간 뒤 루시가 집에 돌아왔다. 프로스 양이 위층으로 올라가서 그녀는 혼자 방에 들어왔다가, 아버지의 의자가 비어있는 것을 보고 놀랐다.

raw: “My father!” she called to him. “Father dear!”
en: "Father!" she called. "Father dear!"
ko: "아버지!" 그녀가 불렀다. "사랑하는 아버지!"

raw: Nothing was said in answer, but she heard a low hammering sound in his bedroom.
en: There was no answer, but she heard a low hammering sound from his bedroom.
ko: 대답은 없었지만, 그의 침실에서 작게 망치질하는 소리가 들려왔다.

raw: Passing lightly across the intermediate room, she looked in at his door and came running back frightened, crying to herself, with her blood all chilled, “What shall I do!
en: She walked quietly to his door. She looked in. She ran back terrified, crying, "What shall I do!
ko: 그녀는 조용히 그의 방문으로 다가갔다. 그녀는 안을 들여다보았다. 그녀는 겁에 질려 뒷걸음질 치며 울부짖었다. "어쩌면 좋지!

raw: What shall I do!”
en: What shall I do!"
ko: 어쩌면 좋아!"

raw: Her uncertainty lasted but a moment; she hurried back, and tapped at his door, and softly called to him.
en: She hesitated only a moment. She went back, knocked on his door, and called him softly.
ko: 그녀는 잠시 주저했다. 그녀는 다시 돌아가 그의 방문을 두드리고는 부드럽게 그를 불렀다.

raw: The noise ceased at the sound of her voice, and he presently came out to her, and they walked up and down together for a long time.
en: The hammering stopped, and he came out. They walked up and down the room together for a long time.
ko: 망치질 소리가 멈추고 그가 나왔다. 그들은 오랫동안 함께 방 안을 서성였다.

raw: She came down from her bed, to look at him in his sleep that night.
en: She went to check on him in his sleep that night.
ko: 그날 밤 그녀는 그가 잘 자고 있는지 확인하러 갔다.

raw: He slept heavily, and his tray of shoemaking tools, and his old unfinished work, were all as usual.
en: He was sleeping heavily, and his shoemaking tools and unfinished work were on the table as usual.
ko: 그는 깊이 잠들어 있었고, 그의 구두 수선 도구와 끝마치지 못한 작업물은 평소처럼 테이블 위에 있었다.
